name: org-and-role-design
description: Three skills for designing organisations and roles for work shared between people and AI: a manager's human and AI organisation-design exercise, a learner-led organisation-structure exercise built on everyday workflows, and a job-description-to-skill-map and course builder.

interface.longDescription: Three skills for managers and teachers. design-human-ai-org takes a manager through one real workflow, splits each position's work between AI and people, and produces current and proposed views of the hierarchy, reporting and decision authority. run-org-structure-exercise lets learners redesign an everyday workflow and then explains span of control, centralisation, standardisation, formalisation and coordination from their own choices. map-job-to-skills turns a job description into a four-pillar skill map and can build a course from it. The skills run in conversation, connect to no company system and take no personnel or system action.
defaultPrompt: Use $design-human-ai-org to redesign one workflow in my team for people and AI agents.
Use $run-org-structure-exercise to run the workflow exercise with me.
Use $map-job-to-skills to turn this job description into a skill map.
